mapper.select: SELECT series_group_id, name FROM series_group WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY series_group_id
mapper.update: UPDATE series_group SET name = #{name} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND series_group_id = #{seriesGroupId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM series_group WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND series_group_id = #{seriesGroupId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.series_id FROM series c JOIN series_group p ON p.series_group_id = c.series_group_id AND p.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND p.name = #{defaultName} AND c.name = #{defaultName}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT figure_id) FROM figure_series_map WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND series_id IN (SELECT series_id FROM series WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND series_group_id = #{seriesGroupId})
